The TribalScale Professional
You thrive in challenging environments where innovation is key. Your passion for technology is matched only by your drive to redefine its limits. You seek more than a job; you seek a calling—a chance to make a lasting impact on the digital landscape.
The Opportunity
We are looking for a talented and driven developer to join a client of TribalScale's team and build the shared, cloud native agent infrastructure on AWS that our AI-assisted modeling pipeline and our internal AI-enabled development workflow run on. A client of TribalScale, builds virtual Arm devices: phones, IoT boards and automotive controllers that run real, unmodified firmware on a client of TribalScale’s CHARM hypervisor. Atlas is our product for virtual IoT, automotive and embedded hardware. Today each new device model takes a team of modeling engineers weeks of reading reference manuals and hand-writing peripheral models. We are building an AI-assisted modeling pipeline that collects vendor documentation, extracts per-peripheral specifications, generates register and system definitions, synthesizes behavioral C code, and validates the result by booting vendor firmware. We use it on our own bring-ups first, then hand it to Atlas partners so they can build and validate their own models.
This role sits on our AI & SDLC Platform team, which supplies agent infrastructure and AI platform support to the delivery teams. Model Delivery owns the modeling backlog and its outcomes. You own the substrate that pipeline runs on: job orchestration, multi-model inference, evaluation hooks, observability and secure deployment. Your work takes the pipeline from an engineer-run prototype to a reliable, measured service. You apply the same infrastructure to replace parts of our internal software development process with AI-enabled workflows.
What You’ll Do
Design and implement orchestration for long-running agent pipelines on AWS: job orchestration, artifact and manifest generation, checkpointing, retries, and prompt and model versioning.
Run multi-model inference across Amazon Bedrock and self-hosted models, with routing, an independent judge model, semantic caching and token-cost and latency controls.
Provide shared evaluation and tracing hooks so Model Delivery can measure each pipeline stage and compare models, prompts and pipeline versions.
Build and operate the internal AI gateway, agent runtime and tool integrations that engineers use in the AI enabled SDLC: code review, ticket-to-merge-request workflows and knowledge retrieval.
Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code (Terraform or CDK) with secure secrets management and least-privilege access.
Instrument agents and pipelines (success rate, cost, latency, failure modes) and maintain dashboards, alerts and runbooks.
Work with the product teams that own customer-facing MCP and API surfaces so internal agent tools and product interfaces stay consistent.
What You Bring
Hands-on experience with AWS services including Bedrock, Lambda, ECS or EKS, S3 and Step Functions.
Experience with GenAI infrastructure: LLM integration, agent frameworks, MCP, semantic caching and LLM evaluation.
Familiarity with Amazon EKS and Kubernetes-based deployments.
Familiarity with GitHub/GitLab workflows, secrets management and secure deployment practices. •
Knowledge of observability tools like Datadog and log aggregation strategies.

A high degree of ownership, curiosity, empathy, and bias toward action.
